name: Microraptor (Hanqiugi)
label: Hanqiugi subspecies
title: Hungerkünstler
note: Born in Dry Fang Canyon, Tallbrush Coasts, Crag Bluffs, Coastland Swamp, Mudflats, Coastal Bluffs and Palm Islands, none of which has fresh water; able to go for longer without food and water. The subspecies is optional and only says where an individual hatched, so its range overlaps the others'. Shares the official Microraptor profile with the Gui and Zhaoianus subspecies.
